title.narrative: Support to General Corporation for Social Security

description.narrative: The IDF will address the following key needs: Ø Actuarial analysis to determine the level of funding necessary to take on non-funded retirees from the former public enterprises. Ø Additional actuarial analysis to determine sustainable levels of contributions and benefits. Ø Also, actuarial analysis to determine the long term trends of assets and liabilities to guide the investment and fund management strategy. Ø Technical assistance to develop an effective and transparent investment strategy according to globally accepted norms. Ø Accounting assistance to help structure the payment systems etc. Ø Overall guidance on pension strategy. Ø Information technology to computerize all data on contributors and beneficiaries in a linked local network. expected outputs from the proposed grant The IDF finance will produce the following outputs: v Data on funds transfer needs to absorb the non-funded retirees from the public enterprises. v Contribution and benefit ratios for a financially sound retirement income systems. v Data on long-term trends in assets and liabilities. v Advice on an investment strategy that is financially sound, transparent and consistent with long-term trends in assets and liabilities. v Advice on improved accounting and payment systems. v A report on a long-term pension strategy. v Computerized data base on contributors and beneficiaries. v
